Performance was supported by healthy ARPP; however, oncology revenues were impacted by the discontinuation of select high-value patented chemotherapy drugs for institutional patients under revised scheme terms, reducing oncology's IP revenue share to 21%.
International patient revenue grew 33% YoY to Rs 307 Cr, contributing 10% of total hospital revenue. • Strong ARPP; Resilient Network Occupancy: ARPP stood at Rs 2.31 Lc, up 8% YoY.
